correctness.rationale: For every \(n\geq1\) and \(k\geq0\), natural integral Kunneth identifies the magnitude group with \(2^n\) weak-composition summands, each Z. Explicit signed shuffle cycles cancel under the actual magnitude boundary; coordinate transpositions change the inversion sign by \((-1)^{a_i a_j}\), with no sign under flips. Translation coinvariants reduce to weak compositions. Each symmetric-group orbit is a partition, with negative stabilizer if and only if an odd part repeats. The resulting integral quotient is one Z or one Z/2 per orbit, with no other torsion. This also proves the unbounded rank bound for fixed \(n=3\) and even k. Independent finite signed-chain and integer Smith-form checks pass in the included code.
